item.tib: gsang sngags gsang ba'i rgyud rgya che rol pa las lha rgod thog pa'i sgrub gzhung
item.coloph: bskal mang gong nas g.yung drung sems dpar spyod/ lnga brgya dran pa'i gyer spungs dran pa yis/ yi ger gtab (btab) nas ma 'ongs gter du sbas/ ma bdud btsan la bka'i gnyer gtad nas/ bsnyan (snyan) rgyad bka' gter ma bu kha sprad nas/ phyi dus mdo smad mu la drung mu la/ mkha' 'gros lung bstan dgongs pa zab yang klong / ma slob 'bad med rang rig khong nas shar/ yi ger ma btab lo gsum gsang rgya gdams/ dus la bab tshe shing pho khyi lo la/ rig 'dzin gsang sngags gling pa bdag gis phab//
